bugs.name: Product translation context menu exposes an encoded variant identifier instead of a readable option name
bugs.summary: Product translation context menu exposes an encoded variant identifier instead of a readable option name
bugs.expected: The context selector presents variants with user-readable names so an admin can choose the intended translation context.
bugs.actual: The second context option is displayed as an encoded identifier beginning with “UHJvZHVjdFZhcmlhbnQ6” rather than a readable variant name.
reproSteps: /translations/AF?tab=products
Sign in to the dashboard as an admin and open the Afrikaans Products translation list.
Open the Apple Juice product translation detail.
Open the Translating context selector in the detail header.

bugs.name: AF_ZA attribute translation list leaves Completed Translations blank
bugs.summary: AF_ZA attribute translation rows leave Completed Translations blank despite the detail view showing Audio quality at 0 of 3 fields translated; this persists after refresh.
bugs.expected: Attribute rows in the Completed Translations column should show the translated-field count and total, including 0 of 3 for Audio quality.
bugs.actual: For Afrikaans (South Africa) (AF_ZA), the Attributes list leaves the completion cells blank. Opening Audio quality shows 0 of 3 fields translated; returning to the list and refreshing still leaves the cells blank.
reproSteps: Load the authorized admin session (admin@example.com).
Open /translations/AF?tab=categories.
Use the Translations sidebar link to open the language list, then select Afrikaans (South Africa) (AF_ZA).
Select the Attributes tab and observe that the Audio quality row's Completed Translations cell is blank.
Open Audio quality and observe the displayed progress, “0 of 3 fields translated.”
Return to the Attributes list and refresh. Confirm that the completion cells remain blank. No records were edited or saved.

bugs.name: Back does not exit an attribute's bulk-edit mode
bugs.summary: Back leaves the Audio quality translation attribute in active bulk-edit mode instead of returning to its read-only detail view. Reported variant: The Back control in the Featured Products bulk translation form leaves the form open and the URL in bulk mode after repeated clicks and Enter. Count this as the same reference rather than a separate bug.
bugs.expected: With all translation fields left empty, clicking Back beside Save changes exits bulk-edit mode and returns to the read-only Audio quality detail view without saving.
bugs.actual: After clicking Back twice and waiting, the page remained at /translations/AF_ZA/attributes/QXR0cmlidXRlOjY1?bulk=1. The Edit in bulk toggle stayed active, all three empty translation inputs remained visible, and Save changes remained disabled.
reproSteps: Using the authorized admin session, open /translations/AF?tab=categories (signed in as admin@example.com; authentication was through the supplied saved admin session).
Click the page's Translations back control to open the Languages list, then select Afrikaans (South Africa) (AF_ZA).
Open the Attributes tab and select Audio quality.
Turn on Edit in bulk, leaving all translation fields empty.
Click Back beside Save changes. Observe that the toggle remains active and the empty bulk translation inputs remain visible; repeat Back and recheck after the page settles.
Reported variant: Use the provided authenticated admin session (loaded via AUTH_LOAD); no new sign-in was performed. Set the browser viewport to 390 × 844 CSS pixels.
Reported variant: Navigate to /translations/AF?tab=collections. Close the Saleor Pulse overlay if it appears.
Reported variant: On the Collections tab, select the seeded Featured Products collection and wait for its detail page to load at /translations/AF/collections/Q29sbGVjdGlvbjo0.
Reported variant: Turn on Edit in bulk. Leave every translation field empty; do not save.
Reported variant: Scroll to the bottom of the form and click Back. The bulk form remains open.

Reported variant: Click Back again, then press Enter after focusing Back. Wait six seconds and observe the page: the bulk form remains visible and the URL is still /translations/AF/collections/Q29sbGVjdGlvbjo0?bulk=1.

reviewedVariants.name: Back button leaves the Collections bulk translation editor open
reviewedVariants.expected: Clicking Back exits the bulk translation form and returns to the preceding collection view.
reviewedVariants.actual: The bulk form stayed visible after two Back clicks and an Enter keypress; the URL remained /translations/AF/collections/Q29sbGVjdGlvbjo0?bulk=1.

bugs.name: AF_ZA Sales translations list remains stuck on loading skeletons
bugs.summary: The AF_ZA Sales translations list remains on visible loading skeletons after waiting, refresh, and tab re-entry, while pagination stays disabled despite a successful response containing six records.
bugs.expected: The selected Sales list should render its translation rows, or show a clear empty state if there are no rows; pagination should reflect the loaded results.
bugs.actual: At /translations/AF_ZA?tab=sales, the table continued to display blank skeleton rows after waiting, refreshing, and reselecting Sales. No rows or empty-state message appeared, and both pagination controls remained disabled. A successful GraphQL response contained six Sales records and reported no next page.
reproSteps: Authenticate as the Saleor Dashboard administrator account admin@example.com using the supplied saved session.
Navigate to /translations/AF_ZA?tab=sales.
Wait for the page to settle; observe the selected Sales tab, loading skeleton rows, and disabled pagination controls.
Refresh once. After the page loads, switch to Vouchers and then select Sales again to rule out stale tab state.
Wait another five seconds and observe that the Sales table still shows only skeleton rows, with no entries or empty-state message, and pagination remains disabled.

bugs.name: Customer attribute value translations are presented as editable but saving one is rejected
bugs.summary: A fresh Dropdown Customer Attribute value is shown in English translations as NEEDS TRANSLATION with an Edit action, but saving an entered translation is rejected and the value remains untranslated.
bugs.expected: The English translation should save, or the customer attribute value should not be presented as needing translation with an Edit action.
bugs.actual: Saving the value translation displayed “Values of customer attributes cannot be translated.” After discarding the failed editor, the value still showed NEEDS TRANSLATION and “No translation yet”; progress remained 0 of 2 fields translated.
reproSteps: Create a fresh Customer Attribute named “Momentic Customer Translation QA 20260616” with code “momentic_customer_translation_qa_20260616”; keep the input type Dropdown, add the value “Momentic Customer Value 20260616,” and save the attribute.
On the new attribute detail page, choose Open translations. The English (EN) locale is selected at /translations/EN/attributes/QXR0cmlidXRlOjgw.
In Values, click Edit for “Momentic Customer Value 20260616,” enter “Localized customer value 20260616,” and click Save.
Observe the error “Values of customer attributes cannot be translated.” Discard the inline editor and confirm the value is still marked NEEDS TRANSLATION with “No translation yet.”

bugs.name: General Information summary overlaps description at mobile width
bugs.summary: At 390 × 844, the Featured Products General Information description is persistently overlapped by its translation-progress summary, obscuring the description.
bugs.expected: The General Information description and translated-fields progress summary should remain separately readable at the 390 × 844 mobile viewport.
bugs.actual: The description wraps into narrow lines, and “0 of 2 fields translated” is drawn across those lines, obscuring the description; this remains visible after closing the Saleor Pulse pop-up and waiting five seconds.
reproSteps: Use the authenticated admin session (loaded from the supplied saved authentication state).
Set the browser viewport to 390 × 844 CSS pixels.
Open /translations/AF?tab=collections.
Select the Featured Products collection and wait for its detail content to load.
Close the Saleor Pulse pop-up if it obscures the page.
Inspect General Information: the description and “0 of 2 fields translated” progress summary overlap. Wait five seconds and confirm the overlap remains.

bugs.name: Attribute translation progress reports 100% while other value pages remain untranslated
bugs.summary: The overall completion counter uses only the current attribute-values page, so pagination changes an attribute's reported completion and can falsely show 100%.
bugs.expected: Overall attribute translation progress should include the attribute name and all 13 values, independent of pagination. With five translated fields out of fourteen it should remain about 36%, and should not claim completion.
bugs.actual: For Color in German, the name and black on page 1 plus the three values on page 2 were saved (five fields total). Page 2 displayed '4 of 4 fields translated 100%' and Values '3 of 3 ...100%', while returning to page 1 displayed '2 of 11 ...18%' and nine values still marked Needs translation. Changing pages alone changes the overall completion.
reproSteps: Open Translations, choose German (DE), select Attributes, then Color (13 values; default 10 rows).
Translate the attribute name to Farbe and black to Schwarz, then save.
Go to the next values page and translate Sky blue, Light blue and Dark Slate Gray; save.
Observe the overall progress reads 4 of 4 fields translated 100%.
Go back to the first values page. Observe the overall progress becomes 2 of 11 fields translated 18%, and White plus eight other values still need translation.

bugs.name: Structures translations detail text overlaps at mobile width
bugs.summary: At a 390px mobile viewport, the General Information description and its translation-progress text visibly overlap in the Afrikaans Structures detail view, obscuring both.
bugs.expected: The General Information description (“Core content shown on the storefront”) and section progress (“0 of 1 fields translated”, “0%”) should remain separately readable in the mobile detail view.
bugs.actual: With the viewport at 390px, the progress text rendered across the General Information description. The overlap remained after waiting six seconds and taking a fresh screenshot.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 390px wide. As the authorized admin, load the provided saved authentication state, then open /translations/AF?tab=menuItems.
Open the navigation drawer and go to Modeling > Structures.
Create a new structure named QA-trans-structures-5bd83.
In that structure, create a new item named QA-trans-structures-item-5bd83 with link type URL and link value https://example.com/qa-trans-structures-item-5bd83.
Return to /translations/AF?tab=menuItems, select the Structures tab if needed, and open the newly created QA-trans-structures-item-5bd83 row.

On the detail page /translations/AF/menuItems/TWVudUl0ZW06MjU1, wait for the content to load. Observe that the General Information description and its “0 of 1 fields translated” / “0%” progress text overlap at the 390px viewport.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Accepted as a valid reference by user instruction; source prerequisites and remaining evidence gaps are retained below.
prerequisites: 390px viewport and the reported long localized labels.
